facts.text: Olumi's what-if for 'Effect of each extra tech lead on productivity', not their figure: −5 to 15 %/tech lead. Basis: A lead's first months go on hiring, reviews and decisions, so the team's output may dip a little or rise by the launch date.

Olumi's what-if for 'Effect on productivity if Developers grew by as many again as there are now', not their figure: 0 to 60%. Basis: A team that doubled would add at most its own output again, much less while new people settle in before the launch date.

Olumi's what-if for 'Effect of each extra tech lead on defects found after release', not their figure: −20 to 5 %/tech lead. Basis: Closer review and clearer technical decisions usually cut defects; a new lead may also unsettle habits at first.

Olumi's what-if for 'Effect on defects found after release if Developers grew by as many again as there are now', not their figure: −12 to 60%. Basis: New developers on an unfamiliar codebase tend to add defects at first, more under a launch deadline, and more the larger their share of the team.
Olumi's what-if for 'Chance: A new hire adds little before the launch', not their figure: 20% to 50%. Basis: Hiring and settling in within three months is often missed in a tight market.

Olumi's what-if for 'Share kept if it happens: A new hire adds little before the launch', not their figure: 0.1 to 0.6. Basis: If the hire lands late, only part of their effect arrives before the launch date.

size.line: In this what-if, 'Hire a Tech lead' on 'Increase productivity': the chance is about 18% before and after, met in the same draws of all 10,000; the middle of 'Change in productivity' stays at 2.62%.

In this what-if, 'Hire two developers' on 'Increase productivity': the chance moves from about 29% to about 24%, −6 percentage points (−6 to −5) on the same draws; the middle of 'Change in productivity' moves from 5.23% to 4.48%.

In this what-if, 'Hire a Tech lead and one developer' on 'Increase productivity': the chance moves from about 34% to about 31%, −3 percentage points (−3 to −2) on the same draws; the middle of 'Change in productivity' moves from 5.67% to 5.22%.

In this what-if, 'Hire a Tech lead' on 'Maintain code quality': the chance is about 74% before and after, met in the same draws of all 10,000; the middle of 'Change in defects found after release' stays at −4.84%.

In this what-if, 'Hire two developers' on 'Maintain code quality': the chance is about 22% before and after, met in the same draws of all 10,000; the middle of 'Change in defects found after release' moves from 6.01% to 5.16%.

In this what-if, 'Hire a Tech lead and one developer' on 'Maintain code quality': the chance moves from about 58% to about 60%, +2 percentage points (+2 to +2) on the same draws; the middle of 'Change in defects found after release' moves from −2.05% to −2.44%.

rows.title: The chance that 'Hire a Tech lead' meets 'Increase productivity', in this model on current information. Without Olumi's suggested risk assumption 'A new hire adds little before the launch', which is Olumi's own hypothesis and a different model from this one, the chance is about 26%. It rests on Olumi's what-if ranges for 'Effect of each extra tech lead on productivity' (−5 to 15 %/tech lead), 'How likely it is that A new hire adds little before the launch' (20% to 50%), 'How much of the change in productivity remains if it happens' (0.1 to 0.6). It rests on Olumi's proposed figures for 'A new hire adds little before the launch', not yet confirmed by them.

The chance that 'Hire a Tech lead' meets 'Maintain code quality', in this model on current information. It rests on Olumi's reading of the aim and Olumi's proposed target (at most 0%), not yet confirmed by them. It rests on Olumi's what-if ranges for 'Effect of each extra tech lead on defects found after release' (−20 to 5 %/tech lead). Olumi has not modelled: Maintainability, design and test coverage.

likely.title: Among the options compared, 'Hire a Tech lead' is more likely to achieve 'Maintain code quality' in this model (about 74%, against about 60% for 'Hire a Tech lead and one developer'); it rests on Olumi's estimate of 'Effect on defects found after release if Developers grew by as many again as there are now' — give yours with ✎. It rests on Olumi's reading of the aim and Olumi's proposed target (at most 0%), not yet confirmed by them. It rests on Olumi's proposed settings: 'Hire a Tech lead and one developer' using 'Hire a Tech lead: how many Tech leads', not yet confirmed by them. Olumi has not modelled: Maintainability, design and test coverage.
